tradingControl.title: Trading state
tradingControl.unavailable: Trading state unavailable. Actions are disabled until it can be read.
tradingControl.noDecision: No trading decision recorded — treated as HALTED.
tradingControl.cancelAllNone: No venue cancel-all is recorded for this stop. Use the kill switch to run it.
tradingControl.cancelAllIncomplete: The venue may still hold funding offers. Retry the kill switch or cancel them by hand.
tradingControl.resumeCli: Resuming goes through the operator CLI on the VM:
tradingControl.killBody: Writes HALTED and cancels every funding offer at the venue in every currency, including offers you placed by hand. Loans already taken keep running until they end. Resuming afterwards goes through the operator CLI (bfx-op resume).
tradingControl.applied: Every action is applied by the trading daemon.
tradingControl.waitingKill: Kill queued; it is applied before anything else.

error.request_pending: Another request is still waiting for the daemon.
error.forbidden: Only the operator can do this.
error.policy_unavailable: This currency has no applied policy.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.hint: Disabling a currency stops new offers and cancels the bot's own open offers for it; offers placed by hand and loans already taken are untouched. It does not halt the account.
currencies.none: No currency has an applied policy.
currencies.unreadableBody: The daemon refuses every offer for this currency until its policy can be read ({code}).
currencies.envelopeUnset: Offer limits not set: every offer for this currency is refused until they are (amend_capital_policy).
currencies.envelope: Up to {max} per offer · {minDays}–{maxDays} days · at most {offers} open offers · rate floor: the higher of {apr} a year and {ratio} × the median bid
